name: two-position
why: A tote press and the cart outside it: the paired position is no claim's, so the press is fed from behind and SEND BACK's line may show.

name: three-position
why: A three-position press: the paired position (the middle) is no claim's, and the second paired position is never the outside, so the shape reads fed by its paired position alone.

name: sequential
why: Two presses that alternate name each other as paired, and each is a claim of the same process and style: neither is the other's outside.

name: consume
why: The shape is role-blind: a consume press fed from behind reads fed. SEND BACK's line refuses it by its own role test.

name: blank paired
why: A claim with no paired position has no outside.

name: stale paired, as the save stores it
why: A claim on a mode that names no paired position (two_robot here) sent one anyway: the Edge claim save drops it (domain NodeClaimInput.SavedPairs), so the row Core mirrors carries none and has no outside, and the Edge chain finds no dependent position either. Before the save rule the row kept the name, Core read the claim as fed and the Edge chain did not.
